Find the polynomial \(P{\left(X \right)}\) such that:
  • \(gcd (P(X),P'(X)) = \left(X - 2\right)^{3} \left(X - 1\right)^{2}\) , where \(P'(X)\) is the derivative of \(P{\left(X \right)}\) ;
  • \(P{\left(-0.5 \right)} = 527.34375\) ;
  • the degree of \(P{\left(X \right)}\) is as small as possible.
You may enter your polynomial under any form. developed or factored x^3 Type \(X^{3}\), etc.
